- Tier 3 or no tier indicated : All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.

Background

The United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) is the UN’s global development network, working in around 170 countries and territories. In Bosnia and Herzegovina, UNDP is committed to helping the country through strengthened national and local capacities to carry out political, economic and social reforms and promote development. In line with its 2026-2030 Country Programme, UNDP in Bosnia and Herzegovina (BiH) focuses on inclusive green growth, human capital development and accountable institutions and social cohesion. UNDP is fully committed to supporting BiH in achieving its Agenda 2030 commitments and advancing its European Union (EU) integration priorities. Across all areas of work, UNDP applies conflict-sensitive, integrated, and innovative approaches tailored to the country's development needs.

Accelerating Rights-Based Trade and Investment in BiH (ARTI BiH) aims to strengthen responsible business conduct in Bosnia and Herzegovina by supporting policy dialogue, institutional capacity development and practical application of human rights and environmental due diligence standards. The project responds to the growing importance of responsible business conduct for Bosnia and Herzegovina’s EU accession process, competitiveness and participation in EU-linked value chains, particularly in light of evolving EU and international sustainability requirements. The project seeks to address existing gaps in the readiness of public institutions, the private sector, financial institutions and the broader business support ecosystem to implement responsible business conduct in practice. Particular attention is placed on strengthening capacities of SMEs and relevant support institutions to understand and apply the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights (UNGPs), Human Rights Due Diligence (HRDD), environmental due diligence and related EU sustainability requirements.

The project is structured around three mutually reinforcing areas. First, it will support national policy dialogue and development of a roadmap for a National Action Plan on Business and Human Rights. Second, it will establish a Business and Human Rights Innovation Lab and strengthen cooperation with academia and Business Development Support Organizations to develop practical knowledge products, technical guidance and the functional concept for a digital HRDD/RBC self-assessment tool. Third, the project will work with the financial sector to strengthen understanding and integration of Business and Human Rights considerations into risk assessment and advisory practices. The project applies a human rights-based and gender-responsive approach, recognizing that business operations, supply-chain changes and sustainability requirements can affect women and other groups differently. Gender considerations will therefore be mainstreamed across relevant technical assistance, capacity-building, stakeholder engagement and knowledge-development activities.

To support the implementation of the project, the Business and Human Rights Analyst will provide day-to-day coordination and substantive support to the implementation of project activities, including work planning, stakeholder engagement, monitoring, reporting and knowledge management, in close cooperation with government institutions, private sector actors, academia, financial institutions, business support organizations and other relevant partners.

Duties and Responsibilities

Under the direct supervision of the Sustainable Growth Sector Leader, the Business and Human Rights Analyst will be responsible for the following functions:

a) Contribute to coordination and implementation of project activities

- Contribute to the day-to-day coordination and implementation of project activities in accordance with the approved work plan and agreed timelines;

- Contribute to the preparation and regular updating of project work plans, activity schedules and implementation arrangements;

- Coordinate with relevant government institutions, private sector actors, academia, Business Development Support Organizations, financial institutions, civil society and development partners to facilitate timely implementation of project activities;

- Support the organization and coordination of meetings, consultations, policy dialogues, workshops, trainings and other project events;

- Monitor progress of project activities and follow up on agreed actions, timelines and deliverables;

- Contribute to the preparation of project progress updates, reports, briefing notes, presentations and other implementation-related documentation.

b) Substantive and technical support on Business and Human Rights and responsible business conduct

- Provide substantive and technical support to activities promoting responsible business conduct, the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights and Human Rights Due Diligence;

- Contribute to the organization and implementation of multi-stakeholder policy dialogue related to Business and Human Rights and development of the roadmap for a National Action Plan;

- Prepare and review analytical inputs, guidance materials, knowledge products and other technical documentation related to Business and Human Rights, HRDD and relevant EU and international sustainability requirements;

- Contribute to the cooperation with academia and Business Development Support Organizations in the development and dissemination of practical tools, guidance and capacity-building materials;

- Contribute to the development of the functional and operational concept for the planned digital HRDD/RBC self-assessment tool, including coordination of relevant stakeholder inputs.

c) Engagement with the private and financial sectors

- Facilitate engagement with companies, SMEs, business associations, Chambers of Commerce and other private-sector actors on responsible business conduct and Human Rights Due Diligence;

- Coordinate and support capacity-building and awareness-raising activities targeting private-sector actors;

- Facilitate engagement with the Association of Banks of BiH, the Central Bank of BiH and commercial banks in activities related to the integration of Business and Human Rights considerations into financial-sector risk assessment and advisory practices;

- Facilitate dialogue and knowledge exchange between the private sector, financial institutions, public institutions, academia and other relevant stakeholders;

- Ensure the documentation of experiences, lessons learned and emerging good practices from engagement with businesses and financial-sector actors.

d) Gender equality, monitoring and knowledge management

- Ensure that gender equality and human rights considerations are appropriately reflected in the planning and implementation of relevant project activities;

- Support gender-responsive stakeholder engagement and contribute to ensuring that project activities address relevant barriers and risks affecting women, including women-led enterprises and women-dominated workforces;

- Support collection, consolidation and analysis of project monitoring data and information in line with the project Results Framework;

- Contribute to documenting results, lessons learned, and evidence generated through project implementation;

- Support knowledge management, communication and dissemination of project results and knowledge products;

- Contribute to identifying opportunities for further programme development, partnerships and scale-up based on evidence and lessons generated through the project.

The incumbent may be required to perform other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the successful implementation of the project and the overall functioning of the Office and the Organization.

Learn Continuously:

Required Skills and Experience

Min. Education requirements

- Advanced University degree (Master’s degree or equivalent) in economics, human rights, business administration, public administration, law, international relations, political sciences, development studies, social sciences or a related field is required, or

- A first-level University degree (Bachelor’s degree) in the above-mentioned fields in combination with additional two years of qualifying experience will be given due consideration.

- Applicants with a Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) are required to have a minimum of two (2) years of relevant professional work experience in project coordination, private sector development, business support, human rights, responsible business conduct or related fields.

Knowledge, Experience and Skills

- Previous experience in project coordination and implementation in development programmes or initiatives involving multiple stakeholders.

- Strong experience in coordinating and working effectively with public institutions, private sector actors, financial institutions, academia, civil society organizations and other relevant stakeholders.

- Previous experience in providing technical support to private sector actors, SMEs, business associations or Business Development Support Organizations.

Approche Tiers

Veuillez noter le niveau approprié indiqué dans le titre de l'avis de vacance de poste et vous assurer que vous détenez le type de contrat correspondant, tel que défini ci-dessous :

- Niveau 0 : Personnel international du PNUD/FENU/VNU titulaire d'un contrat permanent (PA) ou à durée déterminée (FTA), dont les postes seront supprimés, ou dont les contrats seront résiliés ou non renouvelés en 2026

- Niveau 1 : Autre personnel du PNUD/FENU/VNU titulaire d'un contrat permanent (PA) ou à durée déterminée (FTA)

- Niveau 2 : Personnel du PNUD/FENU/VNU titulaire d'un contrat temporaire (TA), personnel sous contrat PSA régulier, et Volontaires des Nations Unies Experts et Spécialistes

- Niveau 3 ou aucun niveau indiqué : Tous les autres types de contrat du PNUD/FENU/VNU et d'autres agences, ainsi que les candidats externes

Veuillez prendre note du ou des niveaux (« Tier(s) ») indiqués dans le titre de la vacance de poste, le cas échéant, et vous assurer que vous remplissez les conditions d’éligibilité pour postuler.

1. Contexte

Le PNUD travaille avec les pays afin d’élargir les choix qui s’offrent aux personnes pour un avenir plus juste et durable, comme le prévoit le Programme de développement durable à l’horizon 2030, l’objectif étant de bâtir un avenir dans lequel aucun pays n’aurait à choisir entre le développement humain et la santé de la planète, où la prospérité et la durabilité iraient main dans la main et où personne ne serait laissé de côté. Dans cette perspective le PNUD, dans sa collaboration avec ses partenaires, entend privilégier une approche intégrée et systémique au lieu de se focaliser sur les secteurs. Le PNUD, dans son nouveau plan stratégique 2026-2029, s’engage à promouvoir le développement de solutions intégrées qui tout en faisant avancer les priorités de développement socioéconomiques liées à la gouvernance, à la prospérité et à la résilience contribuent aussi à relever les défis environnementaux et sociaux que représentent les changements climatiques, les catastrophes, la perte de biodiversité, l’énergie, la santé publique, les produits chimiques et les déchets. C’est sous ce paradigme que l’accompagnement du PNUD à la réalisation de l’ODD 7 qui vise à garantir l’accès de tous à des services énergétiques fiables, durables et modernes, à un coût abordable se met en œuvre. L'accès à une énergie propre, moderne et abordable est un facteur essentiel du développement durable, que ce soit pour la nutrition, le transport, l'éducation ou les opportunités économiques. Le PNUD entend développer et renforcer les partenariats avec les gouvernements, les autres partenaires au développement, le secteur privé, les OSCs et les communautés pour l'amélioration de l'accès à l'énergie, la promotion des énergies renouvelables et le renforcement de l'efficacité énergétique d'une manière qui soit inclusive et qui réponde aux besoins des différents secteurs de la population (urbain/rural, femmes/hommes, ménages/entreprises), conformément aux aspirations de l'objectif de développement durable 7.

Le Contexte du Congo

La République du Congo fait face à un important déficit d’accès à l’électricité, particulièrement en zones rurales où le taux d’électrification reste inférieur à 1 %, selon le ministère de l’Énergie et de l’Hydraulique (MEH). Malgré les progrès réalisés ces dernières années en matière d’électrification, l’offre d’électricité reste très insuffisante pour répondre aux besoins croissants des populations. Par ailleurs, l’électrification hors-réseau est entravée par plusieurs défis : un cadre réglementaire insuffisamment adapté, une disponibilité limitée de financements, des capacités techniques locales faibles et des coûts élevés d’investissement.

Pourtant, le Congo bénéficie d’un potentiel exceptionnel en énergies renouvelables, notamment en hydroélectricité de petite et moyenne puissance, en solaire photovoltaïque et en biomasse. Conformément aux orientations du Plan National de Développement (PND 2022–2026), le Gouvernement a affiché sa volonté de renforcer les infrastructures énergétiques et d’accélérer la transition énergétique.

Pour répondre à ces défis, le Gouvernement du Congo, en collaboration avec le PNUD, a développé le programme d’électrification des zones rurales (PEZOR). Le PEZOR constitue la réponse structurée à ces défis. L’objectif du PEZOR est de créer les conditions pour un développement communautaire intégré à travers l’accès à l’énergie durable, particulièrement les solutions innovantes d’électrification hors-réseau basée sur une exploitation des ressources d’énergies renouvelables, spécifiquement l’hydroélectricité et l’énergie solaire, en collaboration avec le secteur privé.

Spécifiquement le projet vise trois résultats stratégiques: i) l’opérationnalisation d’un cadre national de gouvernance des énergies renouvelables intégrant une perspective de transition énergétique durable est opérationnalisé ; ii) la résorption du gap énergétique dans au moins 50 localités rurales, à travers l'accès à une source d'énergie propre, durable et à des coûts abordables pour les populations les plus pauvres ; iii) la mise en place des conditions pour la vitalisation socio-économique des localités isolées, permettant la création de revenus durables et le déploiement de services sociaux de base dont le numérique, pour plus de 1 Millions d’ habitants de 90 districts, dont 50% de femmes.

C’est dans cette perspective que le PNUD recrute un(e) Analyste au projet PEZOR (Chef.fe de projet) pour assurer la planification, la mise en œuvre opérationnelle, la gestion technique et administrative, ainsi que le suivi du PEZOR.

2. Principales fonctions

Sous la supervision directe du Représentant Résident Adjoint et en étroite collaboration avec le Directeur National du Projet, l’Analyste au projet PEZOR (Chef.fe de projet), devra apporter une gamme de services de conseils, avis, orientations techniques permettant à la Représentante Résidente du PNUD de prendre les décisions de gestion adéquate, alignées avec les besoins du Gouvernement du Congo, et les exigences du partenaires financier. De manière spécifique il s’agit, de manière non limitative, des fonctions et responsabilités ci-dessous :

- Fournir une expertise technique et une orientation stratégique à la Représentante Résidente du PNUD et au Ministre, pour la conduite harmonieuse et la finalisation de toutes les composantes du projet,

- Apporter un contrôle qualité des interventions,

- Apporter des conseils et orientations de qualité supérieure au Directeur désigné du Programme

- Assurer la gestion quotidienne du projet

- Intégrer l’égalité de genre dans la conception, la mise en œuvre et le suivi du projet en veillant à ce que l’égalité de genre et l’inclusion soient intégrées de manière transversale dans l’ensemble du cycle du projet

De manière spécifique, il aura pour missions de :

1.Assurer la direction des activités et la réalisation des objectifs et des résultats du projet, en concentrant son action sur l’obtention des résultats suivants :

- Coordonner l’élaboration et la mise en œuvre des plans de travail budgétisés annuels du projet conformément au descriptif du projet et en étroite coordination avec les parties prenantes au projet et les membres de l’Unité de gestion du projet ;

- Superviser et coordonner la formulation et la mise en œuvre des plans de passation des marchés, de ressources humaines, de communication et de gestion des risques du projet ;

- Établir des procédures et des systèmes de suivi appropriés tout au long des activités du projet en consultation et en collaboration avec le ministère, le PNUD et les autres partenaires ;

- Gérer l’établissement de rapports exacts, opportuns et de haute qualité sur l’avancement du projet et la réalisation des objectifs annuels à l’intention du Senior Management du PNUD Congo, du ministre de l’Energie et de l’Hydraulique et des autres bailleurs;

- Veiller à la mise en œuvre des activités de communication du projet ;

- Assurer l’organisation des réunions du comité de pilotage et des comités techniques du projet et veiller à la préparation en temps utile de l’ordre du jour, des documents de référence pour les points inscrits à l’ordre du jour et des procès-verbaux ;

- Faciliter les consultations avec les collectivités locales et les populations bénéficiaires.

2. Assurer la gestion administrative et financière du projet:

- Superviser la fourniture efficace de services aux parties prenantes au projet, selon les besoins ;

- Surveiller l’exécution du budget et la comptabilité pour assurer l’exactitude et la fiabilité des dépenses du projet ainsi que l’application cohérente des règles et règlements du PNUD.

- Gérer les demandes de fourniture de ressources financières par le PNUD, au moyen des avances de fonds, des paiements directs ou des remboursements, en ayant recours à l’autorisation de financement et ordonnancement des dépenses (FACE) ;

- Assurer le suivi des contrats, paiements, passations de marchés et engagements financiers.

- Garantir la conformité avec les procédures nationales, du PNUD et des bailleurs.

- Coordonner la préparation des rapports financiers adressés au PNUD, selon les besoins ;

- Coordonner le personnel du projet, les équipes techniques, consultants, partenaires, entreprises et bureaux d’études. Élaborer des termes de référence pour les consultations et autres emplois à court terme ;

- Établir des objectifs et des normes de performance et assurer des retours d’informations, des conseils et un soutien opportun et approprié pour assurer une performance optimale ;

- Entreprendre une évaluation du rendement du personnel de gestion de projet ;

3. Assurer et coordonner la fourniture d’avis techniques de haute qualité et la création de partenariats, en focalisant son action sur l’obtention des résultats suivants :

- Assurer l’identification, la mobilisation et la coordination des inputs et la fourniture des délivrables des experts techniques

- Coordonner les activités d’appui technique du projet et d’implication des experts techniques nationaux

- Faire en sorte que les produits techniques soient fournis conformément aux plans et aux normes techniques les plus strictes.

- Examiner et valider la qualité des produits techniques ;

- Établir, maintenir et faciliter un dialogue stratégique entre le personnel du PNUD, le personnel du projet et les responsables gouvernementaux aux niveaux central et local, dans les domaines d’activité du projet ;

- Fournir des avis techniques, des projets de documents/notes/propositions sur l’orientation technique du projet ;

4. Faciliter la communication, l’acquisition et la gestion des connaissances et le renforcement des capacités:

- Veiller à ce que le projet renforce systématiquement les capacités des parties prenantes grâce à l’introduction d’innovations et de meilleures pratiques, à l’accès aux connaissances et à l’expertise, et promeuve leur application à la mise en œuvre du projet ;

- Promouvoir le partage d’informations et la collaboration au sein de l’équipe de projet et entre celle-ci et les partenaires gouvernementaux et le PNUD ;

- Promouvoir le développement des compétences du personnel du projet par le biais de l’encadrement et du mentorat ;

- Appuyer la communication sur les avancées du programme.

- Veiller à ce que des enseignements soient tirés de la mise en œuvre du projet et diffusés ;

- Faciliter la représentation du projet et/ou participation à des réseaux internationaux de connaissances pour exploiter et partager les meilleures pratiques et les enseignements tirés

Compétences

Compétences Clés

Atteindre les résultats : Niveau 1: Planifier et surveiller son propre travail, prêter attention aux détails, livrer un travail de qualité dans les délais impartis

Penser de manière innovante: NIVEAU 1 : Ouvert aux idées créatives/aux risques connus, pragmatique dans la résolution de problèmes, apporte des améliorations

Apprendre continuellement: NIVEAU 1 : Ouvert d’esprit et curieux, partage ses connaissances, apprend de ses erreurs, demande des commentaires

S’adapter avec agilité : NIVEAU 1: S’adapte au changement, gère de manière constructive l’ambiguïté et l’incertitude, fait témoignage de souplesse

Agir avec determination: NIVEAU 1 : Fait preuve d’entrain et de motivation, capable de livrer calmement face à l’adversité, confiant

Engagement et partenariat : NIVEAU 1 : Fait preuve de compassion/compréhension envers les autres, forme des relations positives

Favoriser la diversité et l'inclusion: NIVEAU 1 : Planifier et surveiller son propre travail, prêter attention aux détails, livrer un travail de qualité dans les délais impartis

Compétences techniques et cross-fonctionnelles:

Orientation et stratégie commerciales - Pensée systémique: Capacité à utiliser une analyse objective des problèmes et son jugement pour comprendre comment des éléments interdépendants coexistent au sein d'un processus ou d'un système global, et à examiner comment la modification d'un élément peut avoir un impact sur d'autres parties du système.

Business Management -Gestion axée sur les résultats: Capacité à gérer la mise en œuvre de stratégies, de programmes et de projets en vue d'améliorer les performances et d'obtenir des résultats concrets. Connaissance et compréhension des théories, concepts, méthodologies, instruments et outils pertinents.

Business Management- Communication: Communiquer de façon claire, concise et sans ambiguïté, tant à l'écrit qu'à l'oral ; adapter les messages et choisir les méthodes de communication en fonction du public.

Gérer la communication interne et externe, via les médias, les réseaux sociaux et autres canaux appropriés.

Business Direction & Strategy -Reflexion stratégique: Capacité à utiliser l'analyse objective des problèmes et le jugement pour comprendre comment des éléments interdépendants coexistent au sein d'un processus ou d'un système global, et pour envisager l'impact de la modification d'un élément sur d'autres parties du système.

Business Management- Gestion de projet: Capacité à planifier, organiser, prioriser et contrôler les ressources, les procédures et les protocoles afin d'atteindre des objectifs précis.

Partnership management- Engagement stratégique: Capacité à capter et à maintenir l'attention, l'intérêt et l'adhésion des décideurs et responsables politiques influents de haut niveau, et à obtenir leur soutien à une vision et à des objectifs ambitieux.

2030 Agenda Planet- Nature Energie, Climat: Actions nationales et locales

Required Skills and Experience

Exigences minimum en matière d’éducation

• Un diplôme universitaire supérieur (master ou équivalent) en gestion de énergie, en ingénierie, en gestion de projets, économie du développement l'environnement ou des ressources naturelles, en économie, en politiques publiques, en droit, en économie/gestion de l'environnement, en administration des affaires ou dans un domaine connexe est requis.

OU

•Un diplôme universitaire de premier cycle (licence) dans les domaines susmentionnés, assorti de deux années supplémentaires d'expérience qualifiante, sera pris en considération à défaut d'un diplôme universitaire supérieur.

Minimum d'années d'expérience professionnelle pertinente

•Au moins 2 ans (avec un Master) ou 4 ans (avec une licence) d’expérience professionnelle pertinente dans la gestion de projets/initiatives de gestion de l’environnement/des ressources naturelles ou en gestion et coordination de projets d’énergie ou d’infrastructures aux niveaux national ou local sont requis.

Critères souhaitables

• Une expérience à des niveaux de responsabilité de plus en plus élevés en gestion de projets ou de programmes ou dans un domaine connexe, au niveau international et/ou national, est souhaitable.

• Une expérience avérée de la gestion et/ou de la prestation de services pour la conception, la gestion, le suivi et l'évaluation de programmes et/ou de projets de développement du PNUD, y compris la gestion axée sur les résultats, constitue un atout majeur.

• Une expérience dans l'un des domaines thématiques du PMF-FEM au niveau national est hautement souhaitable.

• La connaissance des programmes stratégiques et des politiques opérationnelles du PNUD est un atout.

• Une expérience avérée de travail dans un environnement sensible nécessitant des relations et une collaboration avec de multiples acteurs (par exemple, ONG, OSC, gouvernements, etc.) est souhaitée.

• Expérience avec les bailleurs internationaux.

• Excellentes capacités organisationnelles et rédactionnelles.

Capacités linguistiques

• La Maîtrise du français requise.

• La Connaissance pratique de l’anglais est un atout.

Professional Certificates

N.A

NB : les candidatures féminines répondant au profil du poste sont vivement encouragées.

Égalité des chances

En tant qu'employeur offrant l'égalité des chances, le PNUD valorise la diversité comme une expression de la multiplicité des nations et des cultures dans lesquelles nous opérons. À ce titre, nous encourageons les candidats qualifiés de tous horizons à postuler aux postes au sein de l'organisation. Nos décisions en matière d'emploi sont basées sur le mérite et l'adéquation au poste, sans aucune discrimination.

Le PNUD s'engage également à créer un environnement de travail inclusif où tout le personnel est encouragé à contribuer à notre mission, est valorisé, peut s'épanouir et bénéficier d'opportunités de carrière ouvertes à tous.

Harcèlement sexuel, exploitation et abus d'autorité

Le PNUD ne tolère pas le harcèlement, le harcèlement sexuel, l'exploitation, la discrimination ni l'abus d'autorité. Tous les candidats sélectionnés subissent donc les vérifications appropriées et sont tenus de respecter les normes et principes correspondants.

Droit de sélectionner plusieurs candidats

Le PNUD se réserve le droit de sélectionner un ou plusieurs candidats à partir de cette annonce de poste. Nous pouvons également conserver les candidatures reçues et considérer les candidats postulants à ce poste pour d'autres postes similaires au sein du PNUD, au même niveau de grade et avec une description de poste, une expérience et des exigences éducatives similaires.

Alerte aux arnaques

Le PNUD ne facture aucun frais à quelque étape que ce soit de son processus de recrutement. Pour plus d'informations, veuillez consulter : www.undp.org/scam-alert .

jobs.title: Motorista
jobs.description:
Aproximación por Niveles (Tiered Approach)

De acuerdo con el compromiso de salvaguardar capacidad y apoyar al personal actual de la Organización, la mayoría de vacantes de PNUD/UNCDF/UNV se han anunciado utilizando un proceso de aplicación por niveles (tiers) en donde:

Nivel 0: Personal internacional del PNUD/UNCDF/VNU con nombramientos permanentes (PA) y de plazo fijo (FTA), cuyos puestos sáran abolidos, o cuyos contratos serán rescindidos o no renovados durante el año 2026

Nivel 1: Otro personal del PNUD/UNCDF/VNU con nombramientos permanentes (PA) y de plazo fijo (FTA)

Nivel 2: personal del PNUD/UNCDF/VNU con nombramientos temporales (TA), personal con contratos PSA regulares y Voluntarios Expertos y Eespecialistas de las Naciones Unidas

Nivel 3 o sin nivel indicado: todos los demás tipos de contratos del PNUD/UNCDF/VNU y de otros organismos, y demás candidatos externos

Por favor tenga en cuenta del nivel(es) indicado(s) en el título de la vacante, si lo hay, y asegúrese de que cumple con la elegibilidad para aplicar.

Background

El/la motorista demuestra un enfoque orientado al cliente, un alto sentido de responsabilidad, cortesía, tacto y la capacidad de trabajar con personas de diferentes orígenes nacionales y culturales.

El/la motorista brinda servicios de conducción al personal de operaciones y programas en la oficina de país, consultores y expertos y personal de las Naciones Unidas en misión. También brinda apoyo administrativo básico periódico en el inventario, el protocolo y otros flujos de trabajo operativos.

El Conductor debe tener un alto nivel de conciencia y alerta ante amenazas potenciales y ser capaz de anticipar y evitar/reaccionar de manera creativa y flexible ante situaciones de riesgo.

El/la motorista brindará apoyo administrativo cuando sea necesario.

Alcance del trabajo

- Garantiza la prestación de servicios de conducción fiables y seguros mediante a) la conducción de vehículos de oficina para el transporte del personal autorizado y la entrega y recogida de correo, documentos y otros artículos y b) reuniones con el personal oficial y los visitantes en el aeropuerto, tramitación de visados y trámites aduaneros cuando sea necesario.

- El Conductor debe mostrar un alto nivel de conciencia y alerta ante amenazas potenciales y ser capaz de anticipar y evitar/reaccionar de manera creativa y flexible ante situaciones de riesgo.

- Asegura el ahorro de costos mediante el uso adecuado del vehículo a través del mantenimiento preciso de los registros diarios del vehículo, la provisión de insumos para la preparación de los planes e informes de mantenimiento del vehículo.

- Asegura el adecuado mantenimiento diario del vehículo asignado a través de reparaciones menores oportunas, arreglos para reparaciones mayores, cambios de aceite oportunos, revisión de llantas, frenos, lavado de autos, etc. Limpieza del vehículo al menos 1 vez a la semana, control de insumos de bioseguridad dentro del vehículo.

- Asegura la disponibilidad de todos los documentos/suministros requeridos, incluido el seguro del vehículo, los registros del vehículo, el directorio de la oficina, el mapa de la ciudad/país, el botiquín de primeros auxilios y las piezas de repuesto necesarias.

- Asegura que se tomen todas las acciones inmediatas requeridas por las normas y reglamentos en caso de involucrarse en accidentes.

- Brinda apoyo periódico a los deberes administrativos en la oficina, incluidos los procesos de protocolo básico, así como también ayuda en los procesos de inventario de activos, preparación de agendas para misiones y otro apoyo logístico, como el procesamiento (incluido el archivo/fotocopiado y envío) de documentación relacionada a visados, tarjetas de residencia y otras actividades que puedan ser delegadas.

Acuerdo institucional:

Bajo la guía y supervisión del/a Gerente de Operaciones y Asociado/a Ejecutivo/a de la Representación, el/la motorista brinda servicios de conducción confiables y seguros que garantizan una alta precisión en el trabajo.

Competencias Core

- Lograr resultados: Planifica y monitorea el trabajo propio, presta atención a los detalles, entrega trabajo de calidad en los límites establecidos.

- Pensar de forma innovadora: Tiene apertura a ideas creativas/riesgos conocidos, resuelve problemas de manera pragmática, realiza mejoras.

- Aprendizaje Continuo: Tiene mente abierta y curiosidad, comparte conocimiento, aprende de los errores, pide retroalimentación.

- Adaptarse con agilidad: Se adapta al cambio, maneja la ambigüedad/incertidumbre de manera constructiva, es flexible.

- Actuar con determinación: Muestra determinación y compromiso, capaz de responder calmadamente ante la adversidad, confiado.

- Compromiso y asociación: Demuestra compasión/entendimiento hacia los demás, forma relaciones positivas.

- Favorece la diversidad y la inclusión: Aprecia/respeta las diferencias, reconoce los sesgos inconscientes, confronta la discriminación.

Competencias multifuncionales y técnicas

Área Temática

Nombre

Definición

Administración y operaciones

Gestión de vehículos

Conocimiento de políticas y procedimientos sobre gestión de flota

Administración y operaciones

Gestión de registros y correspondencia

Capacidad para recopilar, registrar, mantener y entregar correo y valijas del PNUD; capacidad para gestionar archivos

Gestión del negocio

Comunicación

Capacidad para comunicarse de manera clara, concisa e inequívoca tanto por escrito como verbalmente; para adaptar

los mensajes y elegir métodos de comunicación en función de la audiencia

Gestión del negocio

Satisfacción del cliente/Gestión de clientes

Capacidad para responder de manera oportuna y apropiada con un sentido de urgencia, proporcionar soluciones consistentes y entregar resultados y/o soluciones oportunos y de calidad para satisfacer y comprender las necesidades reales de los clientes.

Ética

Conocimiento de las políticas de las Naciones Unidas: Ética

Conocimiento y comprensión del Estatuto y Reglamento del Personal de las Naciones Unidas y otras políticas relacionadas con la ética y la integridad.

Calificaciones mínimas

Educación:

- Educación Secundaria requerida (de preferencia bachillerato completo) . Licencia de conducir vigente (anexar evidencias)

Experiencia:

- 2 años de experiencia laboral como conductor; historial de manejo seguro; conocimiento de las normas y reglamentos de conducción y habilidades en reparaciones menores de vehículos;

- Al menos 2 años de experiencia dentro del Sistema de las Naciones Unidas es deseable.

- Deseable si posee cursos de manejo a la defensiva, seguridad en el terreno entre otros. (anexar evidencia)

- Deseable conocimiento básico de paquete de software Office (MS Word, Excel etc)

Habilidades requeridas:

- Habilidad para realizar una variedad de tareas y deberes repetitivos y rutinarios.

- Habilidad para revisar datos, identificar y ajustar discrepancias.

- Capacidad para manejar un gran volumen de trabajo posiblemente bajo limitaciones de tiempo.

- Buen conocimiento de las normas y reglamentos administrativos.

- Capacidad para operar y mantener una variedad de máquinas comerciales computarizadas y equipos de oficina para brindar un servicio eficiente.

- Habilidad para organizar y completar múltiples tareas estableciendo prioridades.

- Demuestra un excelente conocimiento de las normas y reglamentos de conducción y habilidades en reparaciones menores de vehículos.

- Demuestra un excelente conocimiento de los problemas de seguridad.

Idioma requerido:

Fluidez en español. La familiaridad con un segundo idioma de las Naciones Unidas es una ventaja, pero no es un requisito.

Equal opportunity

As an equal opportunity employer, UNDP values diversity as an expression of the multiplicity of nations and cultures where we operate and, as such, we encourage qualified applicants from all backgrounds to apply for roles in the organization. Our employment decisions are based on merit and suitability for the role, without discrimination.

UNDP is also committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all personnel are empowered to contribute to our mission, are valued, can thrive, and benefit from career opportunities that are open to all.

Sexual harassment, exploitation, and abuse of authority

UNDP does not tolerate harassment, sexual harassment, exploitation, discrimination and abuse of authority. All selected candidates, therefore, undergo relevant checks and are expected to adhere to the respective standards and principles.

Right to select multiple candidates

UNDP reserves the right to select one or more candidates from this vacancy announcement. We may also retain applications and consider candidates applying to this post for other similar positions with UNDP at the same grade level and with similar job description, experience and educational requirements.

Use of AI by candidates

Applicants are invited to read UNDP’s guidance for candidates on using AI responsibly in UNDP recruitment and selection

Scam alert

UNDP does not charge a fee at any stage of its recruitment process. For further information, please see www.undp.org/scam-alert.

Data Privacy

Please click here to view UNDP Data Privacy Statement

jobs.title: Assistente de Projetos (2 vagas) (Home Based) - [Open to internal and external applicants]
jobs.description:
Tiered Approach

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:

- Tier 0 : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026.

- Tier 1 : Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments

- Tier 2 : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers

- Tier 3 or no tier indicated : All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.

Objetivo do Cargo e Contexto Organizacional

O Projeto Justiça 4.0 constitui uma das principais iniciativas de transformação digital do Poder Judiciário brasileiro e uma referência internacional em inovação e modernização dos serviços de Justiça. Iniciado em 2020, a partir de acordo de cooperação firmado entre o Conselho Nacional de Justiça (CNJ) e o Programa das Nações Unidas para o Desenvolvimento (PNUD/ONU), o Projeto tem como objetivo desenvolver, aprimorar e disseminar soluções tecnológicas que contribuam para tornar os serviços oferecidos pela Justiça brasileira mais eficientes, eficazes, acessíveis e centrados nas necessidades da população. A iniciativa também busca otimizar a gestão e a prestação jurisdicional, beneficiando magistrados(as), servidores(as), advogados(as) e demais atores do sistema de Justiça. O Projeto está alinhado aos Objetivos de Desenvolvimento Sustentável (ODS) e aos compromissos da Agenda 2030 das Nações Unidas.

Nesse contexto, as pessoas selecionadas atuarão como Assistentes de Projetos, prestando suporte técnico e operacional à implementação de projetos do PJ4.0. Serão selecionadas duas pessoas com atuação remota (home based).

Deveres e responsabilidades

O(a) Assistente de Projetos será responsável por prestar apoio administrativo, operacional e logístico à implementação e monitoramento das ações do Programa Justiça 4.0. O(a) profissional desempenhará atividades essenciais para garantir a conformidade processual, a eficiência dos fluxos administrativos e a correta aplicação das normas operacionais das iniciativas. Para o alcance desse objetivo, o(a) profissional desempenhará as seguintes responsabilidades principais e atividades:

1. Apoio à gestão de pessoas, onboarding e elaboração de (TR):

- Auxiliar na elaboração, revisão formal e tramitação de Termos de Referência (TR) para a seleção de pessoas físicas e jurídicas vinculadas às necessidades do programa;

- Apoiar operacionalmente as etapas de onboarding, integração e desligamento de profissionais vinculados(as) ao Programa Justiça 4.0;

- Apoiar a instrução documental de processos de recrutamento e seleção, bem como o controle de prazos de vigência, cronogramas de renovação e reajustes dos contratos da equipe.

2. Gestão, organização e tramitação eletrônica de processos e documentos:

- Acompanhar, organizar e instruir processos administrativos e comunicações oficiais por meio do Sistema Eletrônico de Informações (SEI) e demais canais institucionais utilizados pelas partes parceiras;

- Realizar lançamentos, registros e transações operacionais nos sistemas corporativos do PNUD, incluindo o Quantum, em conformidade com as orientações das áreas responsáveis;

- Organizar e manter atualizados arquivos digitais e pastas dos projetos, garantindo a padronização, a rastreabilidade, a segurança da informação e o fácil acesso à documentação.

3. Acompanhamento operacional e inserção de dados em plataformas de cooperação internacional:

- Apoiar o monitoramento de projetos de cooperação técnica internacional mediante o preenchimento, atualização e acompanhamento de dados das iniciativas no Sistema de Gestão de Convênios e Parcerias (SIGAP) da Agência Brasileira de Cooperação do Ministério das Relações Exteriores (ABC/MRE);

- Monitorar e apoiar o controle de prazos, cronogramas, metas e entregas dos projetos, identificando desvios e apoiando a articulação interna para a regularização de pendências;

- Auxiliar na compilação de informações para subsidiar o acompanhamento e as atualizações periódicas dos planos de trabalho e cronogramas gerais do programa.

4. Apoio à execução financeira, orçamentária e prestação de contas do PRODOC:

- Prestar suporte na coleta, organização e consolidação de dados orçamentários e financeiros para apoiar a elaboração de relatórios de progresso e prestações de contas periódicas do Documento de Projeto PRODOC;

- Apoiar o acompanhamento e consolidação de informações sobre a execução orçamentária, auxiliando na instrução de revisões orçamentárias e financeiras em conformidade com as normas do PNUD;

- Identificar inconsistências ou pendências financeiras e processuais, auxiliando na compilação de informações para auditorias e avaliações do projeto.

5. Apoio técnico a reuniões, instâncias de governança e documentação:

- Realizar o agendamento, envio de convites e apoio logístico geral para reuniões, oficinas, encontros tripartites e comissões técnicas das iniciativas;

- Elaborar documentos de suporte para reuniões, tais como pautas, memórias de reunião, atas oficiais, listas de presença, resumos executivos e relatórios de encaminhamentos;

- Acompanhar a execução das deliberações e recomendações acordadas nas reuniões e auditorias, monitorando os prazos de cumprimento junto aos(às) responsáveis.

6. Suporte logístico de viagens, diárias e providências operacionais:

- Apoiar a organização logística de viagens nacionais e internacionais dos projetos, incluindo cotações de passagens, reserva de hospedagens e cadastro de viajantes nos sistemas corporativos;

- Apoiar os fluxos de prestação de contas de diárias e passagens recebidas, realizando a conferência preliminar de relatórios de viagem, bilhetes de embarque e documentos fiscais comprobatórios.

7. Apoiar a construção e o compartilhamento de conhecimento relevantes para o projeto:

- Contribuir de forma consistente para redes de conhecimento e comunidades de prática.

- Manter registros organizados de dados do projeto, atividades de campo, estudos de caso, relatos de experiências humanas, fotografias e outros documentos pertinentes que possam subsidiar o compartilhamento de conhecimento e ações de defesa de causas (advocacy).

jobs.description:
Tiered Approach

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:

Tier 0: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026.

Tier 1: Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments

Tier 3 or no tier indicated: All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.

Background

Within UNDP’s Bureau for Management Services (BMS), the Office of Human Resources (OHR), is the Management Consulting Team (MCT), which is constituted of a group of management consulting practitioners available on request to support UNDP offices and units worldwide to improve strategic and organizational effectiveness in line with UNDP’s Strategic Plan and corporate investments in organizational effectiveness and agility. This group is anchored by a core team of management advisors and consultants based in Bonn, who coordinate and deliver management consulting services globally in a participatory manner

Position Purpose

Under the guidance and supervision of the Chief of the Management Consulting Team (MCT), the Management Data Analyst is expected to contribute to support overall organizational effectiveness by making substantive contributions to MCT advisory engagements with internal and external stakeholders, including country offices and headquarters units. The Management Data Analyst undertakes research, data collection, and data analysis; develops data analysis tools and applications; manages databases and data platforms; supports internal coordination and knowledge management; and participates in all MCT engagements using a client, quality, and results-oriented approach. The Management Data Analyst works in close collaboration with the team members in developing content and in the delivery of organizational effectiveness advisory services.

UNDP adopts a portfolio approach to accommodate changing business needs and leverage linkages across interventions to achieve its strategic goals. This is a recognition of the interconnected nature of development risks & crises that the world is facing and that call for assembling of multidisciplinary teams for an integrated & systemic response. Therefore, UNDP personnel are expected to work across issues, units, functions, teams and projects in multidisciplinary teams in order to enhance and enable horizontal collaboration

Key Duties and Responsibilities

1. Undertake research, data collection, and analysis in support of UNDP’s organizational effectiveness focusing on achievement of the following results:

- Undertake research, data collection, and analysis related to organizational performance, organizational effectiveness, and business process reviews;

- Undertake end-to-end data analysis workflows from data collection, data wrangling, data exploration, data modelling, data analysis, data communication, and visualization;

- Create and maintain databases, dashboards, and data management workflows in coordination with BMS/ITM as applicable;

- Develop methodologies, tools, and software applications related to data analysis and organizational performance;

- Make continuous improvements to organizational performance analytics; and

- Support forward-looking analysis on organizational performance to highlight opportunities for MCT engagements.

2. Participate in client advisory engagements and make contributions in support of business transformation engagements focusing on the achievement of the following results:

- Undertake research, data collection, analysis and visualization of information from diverse sources in support of MCT client engagements, including financial modelling and statistical analysis;

- Support development of technical proposals, business cases, and implementation plans/roadmaps;

- Support preparation for and participate in interviews, focus groups and workshops as required;

- Support drafting of written outputs and end-of-engagement reports, as required;

- Follow up with engagement clients on recommendations, as required; and

- Proactively seek, analyze, and apply data sets relevant for MCT engagements.

3. Support data/knowledge management and coordination:

- Maintain MCT’s data and knowledge platforms, including dashboards;

- Develop and maintain MCT’s codebase, database, and data management tools and workflows

- Contribute to the development of templates and standard operating procedures;

- Perform administrative support functions to ensure smooth operations; and

- Support internal coordination, communication, and knowledge management efforts.

Competencies

Core Competencies

- Achieve Results: LEVEL 1: Plans and monitors own work, pays attention to details, delivers quality work by deadline

- Think Innovatively: LEVEL 1: Open to creative ideas/known risks, is a pragmatic problem solver, makes improvements

- Learn Continuously: LEVEL 1 : Open-minded and curious, shares knowledge, learns from mistakes, asks for feedback

- Adapt with Agility: LEVEL 1: Adapts to change, constructively handles ambiguity/uncertainty, is flexible

- Act with Determination: LEVEL 1: Shows drive and motivation, able to deliver calmly in the face of adversity, confident

- Engage and Partner: LEVEL 1: Demonstrates compassion/understanding towards others, forms positive relationships

- Enable Diversity and Inclusion: LEVEL 1: Appreciate/respect differences, aware of unconscious bias, confront discrimination

Cross-Functional & Technical Competencies

- Digital & Innovation — Data collection: Being skilled in Data Sorting, Data Cleaning, Survey Administration, Presentation and Reporting, including collection of Real-Time Data

- Business Management — Business Analysis: Ability to analyse business processes, business requirements, and identify and define solutions that will maximize the value delivered by an organization to its stakeholders.

- Information Management & Technology — Data management and analytics: Ability to structure data, develop dashboards and visualizations. Design data warehouses, data lakes or data platform concepts. Familiarity with Machine learning, natural language processing or generation, and the use of artificial intelligence to support predictive analytics.

- Business Direction & Strategy — Business Acumen: Ability to understand and deal with a business situation in a manner that is likely to lead to a good outcome. Ability to make good judgments and quick decisions within such frameworks. Knowledge and understanding of the operational frameworks in the organization

- Business Management — Working with Evidence and Data: Ability to inspect, cleanse, transform and model data with the goal of discovering useful information, informing conclusions and supporting decision-making

- Business Management — Customer Satisfaction/Client Management: Ability to respond timely and appropriately with a sense of urgency, provide consistent solutions, and deliver timely and quality results and/or solutions to fulfil and understand the real customers' needs. Provide input to the development of customer service strategy. Look for ways to add value beyond clients' immediate requests. Ability to anticipate clients' upcoming needs and concerns.

Required Skills and Experience

Education:

- Advanced University Degree (Master’s Degree or equivalent) in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Computational Sciences, Business Administration, or related fields, is required, or

- A first-level university degree (Bachelor’s Degree) in the above-mentioned areas with an additional 2 years of relevant work experience will be considered in lieu of the master’s degree.

Experience:

- A minimum of two (2) years with a Master’s degree or four (4) years with a Bachelor’s degree of progressively relevant work experience in research, data collection, analysis, and supporting business transformation engagements is required;

- Knowledge and experience of data science/analytics methodologies and approaches is required;

- Advanced knowledge of spreadsheet and database packages, data modelling, statistical analysis and visualization tools required (e.g. SQL, R, Power BI) is required;

- Demonstrated experience in database and cloud computing platforms required (e.g. Azure, Fabric) is desirable;

- Demonstrated hands-on experience in programming languages, libraries and frameworks for use in data science/analytics (e.g. Python, D3.js, DAX) is required;

- Knowledge of practical applications of predictive analytics and generative AI desirable, including experience assessing and validating AI-generated outputs to ensure accuracy, relevance, and consistency;

- Experience in performance improvement, business process reengineering, organizational effectiveness/organization development, process consultation, or management consulting is a distinct advantage;

- Exposure to international development work is an advantage. Knowledge of the UN/UNDP system is desirable.

Language:

- Fluency in English is required

Our employment decisions are based on merit and suitability for the role, without discrimination.

jobs.description:
Background

The United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) works in about 170 countries and territories, helping eradicate poverty, reduce inequalities and exclusion, and build resilience. It thereby helps them sustain progress and achieve the Sustainable Development Goals. In Ukraine, UNDP operates with three programme priorities: Democratic Governance and Inclusive Social Fabric, Inclusive and Sustainable Economic Recovery and Growth, and Sustainable Environment and Energy Transformation.

Since the start of hostilities in 2014 and the full-scale invasion in 2022, UNDP in Ukraine has been present on the ground through its hubs across the country, supporting regional and local authorities and civil society partners in their emergency response and crisis management efforts.

Lessons from the past years informed the development of UNDP’s Country Programme Document (2025-2029) and the scale-up of the Area-Based Recovery (ABR) Framework. The Framework’s programmatic pillars of Reconstruction, Returns, Resilience, and Reforms focus on ensuring community recovery and creating conditions for the return to a development pathway in Ukraine.

Addressing the country’s complex reconstruction and recovery requires a holistic, systems-based response that empowers all parts of society, including government, local authorities, the private sector, and citizens, with the capacity and resources to respond effectively. To ensure a whole-of-society approach, the framework offers an integrated, participatory, and inclusive methodology to advance recovery in communities most affected by the war.

In this context, the Driver-Security Clerk provides reliable, safe driving services, ensures high accuracy, and supports the Administrative Unit in general premises management, demonstrating a client-oriented approach, a high sense of responsibility, courtesy, tact, and the ability to work with people of different national and cultural backgrounds.

Duties and Responsibilities

Safe Driving and Transportation

• Provide timely, reliable, and secure transportation using soft skin and armoured vehicles within the city and to the regions, including overnight trips where required, under conditions of increased security threats. Transport UNDP/UN personnel, consultants, guests, and visitors as authorized by the UNDP Country Office (CO) and UNDSS.

• Ensure that all instructions regulating safe driving behaviour, Rules of the Road, and UN Security policies and procedures for Ukraine, particularly in relation to transportation of UN personnel, are strictly followed.

• Ensure that the vehicle is not left unattended while on mission and conduct a 360-degree vehicle sweep before and after any movement.

II. Vehicle Maintenance and Safety

• Ensure that the assigned vehicles are in good operational condition: conduct daily checks (oil, fuel, brakes, tyres, battery, tool kits, etc) on all assigned vehicles before the commencement of any trip/mission and report any defects to the Transportation Assistant and Administrative Associate for immediate repairs and maintenance.

• Perform routine daily vehicle maintenance and carry out minor emergency mechanical repairs, as required.

• Maintain daily vehicle logs (mileage, fuel consumption, travel routes, signature of passengers) and submit logs to the direct supervisor on a timely basis.

• Ensure that repair and maintenance services of armoured/soft vehicles are performed on a timely basis and with authorization from the direct supervisor.

• Ensure that the vehicle has valid insurance and a first aid kit.

• Ensure that the vehicle is equipped with sufficient Personal Protection Equipment (PPE) for all the passengers and the driver, at least one trauma bag, and, where required by the applicable Security Risk Management (SRM) measures, at least one operational satellite communication solution (e.g. VHF radio, a satellite phone or Starlink).

• Assist in vehicle history records preparation, collecting all vehicle-related documentation (scanned copies of invoices, receipts, acts, insurance certificates, etc.)

III. Logistical and Field Support

• Assist in the organization of logistical preparation of field trips, visiting missions, etc.

• Provide a full range of logistical support, including all necessary provisions for large VIP missions.

• Provide transportation-related support to official personnel and visitors arriving at the train station and facilitate their field travel arrangements.

• Assist in reviewing records related to in-country missions and field trips.

• Raise security clearance requests in the TRIP system for field missions in accordance with applicable security procedures.

• Load/unload light cargo delivered by the vehicle.

IV. Office, Administrative and Security Support

• Support emergency and contingency planning for UNDP road movements and participate in the assigned security capacity-building events and trainings.

• Conduct security briefings for missions if a security professional is not present in accordance with UN Travel SOPs.

• Assist in general maintenance of the office premises.

• Provide clerical support to operational and project activities.

• Drive UNDP vehicle for delivery and collection of mail, documents, pouches, equipment, and other administrative tasks upon request of the direct supervisor.

• Demonstrate respect for gender equality in professional interactions, identify and address sexism and gender discrimination.

The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organization.

Institutional Arrangement

The Driver-Security Clerk is directly supervised and guided by the Administrative Associate, under the matrix supervision of the Field Security Specialist who provides direction on security-related duties and defines security-related work objectives. The Head of the Area-Based Recovery and the Field Operations Manager provide the overall oversight.

Ability to communicate in a clear, concise, and unambiguous manner both through written and verbal communication; to tailor messages and choose communication methods depending on the audience. Ability to manage communications internally and externally, through media, social media, and other appropriate channels.

As the lead United Nations agency on international development, UNDP works in 170 countries and territories to eradicate poverty and reduce inequality. UNDP helps countries develop policies, leadership skills, partnerships and institutional capabilities to achieve the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

As outlined in the UNDP Strategic Plan 2026-2029, UNDP’s work is guided by four strategic objectives that together define the organization’s contribution to human development: expanding prosperity for all, strengthening effective governance, safeguarding a healthy planet and building crisis resilience. These objectives are enabled by three accelerators that drive transformative impact across the portfolio: digital and AI innovation, gender equality and sustainable finance. Through this integrated approach, UNDP supports countries to deliver tangible improvements in people’s lives and to advance sustainable development at scale.

In alignment with the UNDP Strategic Plan, the Regional Programme for Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC) 2026-2029 outlines UNDP strategic offers and priorities for the next four years in the LAC region and identifies sustainable finance as a key accelerator. At the Fourth International Conference on Financing for Development (FfD4), UNDP also launched the LAC Facility for Financing Resilient Human Development (LAC Facility), which is a multi-stakeholder platform focused on enhancing the region’s capacity to mobilize public and private investments. The LAC Facility will be an essential mechanism to support the roll-out of the Regional Programme 2026-2029 in LAC.

UNDP, through its Sustainable Finance Hub (SFH) (https://sdgfinance.undp.org/), supports partners in promoting financing for the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). As an accelerator of the UNDP Strategic Plan, sustainable finance strengthens countries’ ability to mobilize, align and deploy finance at scale for national priorities. UNDP supports international and country level policy reform as a catalyst for system-wide change, stronger policy environments, better-functioning markets and more coherent financing strategies for sustainable development. SFH work is delivered through three interconnected portfolios: 1) Public Finance for the SDGs; 2) Private Finance for the SDGs; and 3) Global & Country Financing Policy Frameworks.

SFH Public Finance for SDGs (PF4SDGs) portfolio supports governments to strengthen public finance systems for sustainable development. Operating across 99+ countries with a portfolio exceeding $200 million, the portfolio provides integrated technical assistance across four core pillars: 1) Tax/Domestic Resource Mobilization, 2) Public Expenditure Efficiency and Effectiveness, 3) Fiscal Policy Coherence, and 4) Digital Fiscal Governance. The portfolio works with Ministries of Finance, Planning, and line ministries to align fiscal policies, tax systems, debt strategies and public expenditure with national development priorities and the 2030 Agenda. UNDP’s comparative advantage in public finance stems from its unique position at the nexus of fiscal policy and development outcomes. Rather than focusing on isolated technical reforms, UNDP empowers governments to adopt whole-of-government and whole-of-society strategies that link fiscal instruments directly to sustainable development impact. This includes facilitating cross-ministerial policy dialogue, building coalitions for reform, integrating governance, climate, gender, health, and resilience priorities into fiscal frameworks, and supporting countries in translating SDG ambitions into fiscally viable implementation pathways.

The Regional Public Finance for SDGs Specialist will report to the Head of Public Finance for SDGs, SFH (Madrid), with a matrix reporting line to the Regional Advisor, SDG Finance – Latin America and the Caribbean, in the Regional Hub for LAC (Panama), while maintaining strong working relationships with the relevant teams/experts from the global SFH, Regional Hub, and Global Policy Network (GPN), as well as the OECD TIWB Secretariat in Paris. The position will be responsible for contributing to the delivery of activities under UNDP’s Public Finance for SDGs initiative in the region, hosted within the Regional Hub for LAC in Panama and the activities will contribute to the implementation of UNDP’s Regional Programme for LAC (2026-2029) and the LAC Facility for Financing Resilient Human Development.

Duties and Responsibilities

Provide Policy Advisory Support

- Provide strategic and technical support to the Regional Hub and SFH for PF4SDGs implementation in the region, working closely with Country Offices, Regional Hub and SFH teams.

- Support Country Offices to provide policy advice to Ministries of Finance, Planning, and matincluding by connecting and building on existing work on the Integrated National Financing Frameworks (INFFs) and financing strategies for SDGs/NDCs/NBSAPs.

- Work with Regional Hub and global SFH teams to provide technical support to the County Offices for the country-level implementation of PF4SDGs related interventions, drafting/reviewing ToRs and concept notes/FPC related materials, technical reporting, and backstopping.

- Guide research and analysis to identify public finance reforms, drawing on PF4SDGs analytical tools and the fiscal policy coherence process.

- Support the Regional Hub and Country Offices to facilitate dialogue and coalition building with government, donors, civil society, and private sector stakeholders.

- Develop/refine frameworks, methodologies, and tools for PF4SDGs implementation.

- Support the design and implementation of TIWB (Tax Inspectors Without Borders) initiatives in the region, including coordination with COs and relevant partners, and ensuring alignment with PF4SDGs objectives.

Advise and support knowledge, Evidence, and Learning

- Conduct horizon scanning and original research on tax, fiscal policy, public financial management (PFM), debt management and related topics.

- Produce policy papers, case studies, and knowledge products for expert and non-expert audiences based on ongoing CO work and regional level initiatives.

- Contribute to UNDP flagship publications, policy briefs, and working papers

- Document lessons learned, innovations, and impact from PF4SDGs interventions, promoting global uptake.

- Support management of communities of practice and facilitate knowledge exchange at regional level.

- Design and deliver training materials, e-learning modules, and capacity-building resources.

- Support the Regional Hub to facilitate South-South and triangular cooperation for peer learning.

Advise on Advocacy, Engagement, and Partnerships

- Support dissemination of key results and recommendations of PF4SDGs in international conferences, expert meetings, and policy dialogues.

- Prepare background papers, briefing notes, and talking points for senior leadership.

- Provide technical and advisory inputs to the Regional Hub and Country Offices to support and cultivate partnerships with IFIs (World Bank, IMF), UN entities, bilateral donors, technical networks, CSOs, and research institutions.

- Provide technical inputs to resource mobilization efforts and contribute to communications products.

Ensure Programme Management and Coordination

- Contribute to results-based management for PF4SDGs, including indicator tracking, performance monitoring, and outcome documentation.

- Prepare technical inputs for donor reports, internal reviews, and portfolio analyses.

- Support recruitment and roster development for public finance expertise.

- Coordinate and monitor regional budget planning, execution, and reporting for PF4SDGs activities, ensuring effective use of resources and compliance with UNDP financial procedures.

- Work closely with Country Offices to support their budget management for PF4SDGs and related initiatives, providing guidance and oversight as needed.

- Support the operational and logistical aspects of TIWB deployments and activities in the region, including reporting, knowledge sharing, and follow-up with Country Offices and partners.

Perform other duties within incumbent’s functional profile as assigned and deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the office and Organization

Institutional Arrangement

The Regional Public Finance for SDGs Specialist will report to the Head of Public Finance for SDGs, SFH (Madrid), with a matrix reporting line to the Regional Advisor, SDG Finance – Latin America and the Caribbean, in the Regional Hub for LAC (Panama), while maintaining strong working relationships with the relevant teams/experts from the global SFH, Regional Hub, and Global Policy Network (GPN), as well as the OECD TIWB Secretariat in Paris.

Competencies

Core Competencies

Achieve Results: LEVEL 3- Set and align challenging, achievable objectives for multiple projects, have lasting impact

Think Innovatively: LEVEL 3- Proactively mitigate potential risks, develop new ideas to solve complex problems

Learn Continuously: LEVEL 3- Create and act on opportunities to expand horizons, diversify experiences

Adapt with Agility: LEVEL 3- Proactively initiate and champion change, manage multiple competing demands

Act with Determination: LEVEL 3- Think beyond immediate task/barriers and take action to achieve greater results

Engage and Partner: LEVEL 3 - Political savvy, navigate complex landscape, champion inter-agency collaboration

Enable Diversity and Inclusion: LEVEL 3 - Appreciate benefits of diverse workforce and champion inclusivity

Cross-functional and technical competencies

- Business Direction & Strategy - Systems Thinking: Ability to use objective problem analysis and judgement to understand how interrelated elements coexist within an overall process or system, and to consider how altering one element can impact on other parts of the system.

- Business Management - Partnerships Management: Build and maintain partnerships with wide networks of stakeholders, Governments, civil society and private sector partners, experts and others in line with UNDP strategy and policies.

- Business Management - Results-based Management: Ability to manage the implementation of strategies, programmes, and projects with a focus at improved performance and demonstrable results. Knowledge and understanding of relevant theories, concepts, methodologies, instruments, and tools.

- Business Development - Knowledge Generation: Ability to research information and to turn it into useful knowledge, relevant for context, or responsive to a stated need. Ability to apply existing concepts to new situations, and to develop new concepts to generate workable solutions and new approaches. Knowledge of relevant concepts, conceptual models, and theories that can be useful in addressing new situations.

- Partnership management - Multi-stakeholder engagement and funding: Knowledge and ability to forge multi-stakeholder partnerships, and remove any obstacles to resource mobilization and multi-stakeholder funding platforms.

- 2030 Agenda: Partnerships - SDG Finance: Public Finance for the SDGs

- 2030 Agenda: Partnerships - SDG Finance: Taxation and the SDGs

Required Skills and Experience

Education:

- Advanced university degree (Master's degree or equivalent) in economics, finance, public administration or related field is required. OR

- A first-level university degree (Bachelor's degree) in the areas mentioned above in combination with an additional two years of qualifying experience will be given due consideration in lieu of the advanced university degree.

Experience:

- Minimum of five (5) years (with Master's degree) or seven (7) years (with Bachelor's degree) of relevant professional experience in positions directly linked to public finance, taxation, budgeting or financing for development is required.

- Experience in advising international institutions and/ or governments on public finance management, taxation, budgeting and financing for development in Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC) is required.

- Experience in policy research in public finance in LAC is required.

- Demonstrated experience in producing written analytical products such as concept notes, outcome reports, or other project/programme documentation is required.

Desired additional skills/ experiences

- Experience working with international organizations, UN agencies, development banks, or similar developmental institutions is an asset.

- Experience supporting regional or multi-country programmes in Latin America and the Caribbean is an asset.

- Experience with the Tax Inspectors Without Borders (TIWB) programme or similar public finance related technical assistance programmes is an asset.

- Experience with SDG financing frameworks or Integrated National Financing Frameworks (INFFs) is an asset

- Experience with interpreting economic data and translating complex analysis into clear, policy-relevant insights is an asset.

- Experience producing concise, high-quality written outputs for technical and non-technical audiences is an asset.

- Experience with the regional context of Latin America and the Caribbean is an asset.

Required Language(s)

- Fluency in English and Spanish is required

- Knowledge of another UN language is desired.

Our employment decisions are based on merit and suitability for the role, without discrimination.

UNDP is also committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all personnel are empowered to contribute to our mission, are valued, can thrive, and benefit from career opportunities that are open to all.

UNDP does not tolerate harassment, sexual harassment, exploitation, discrimination and abuse of authority. All selected candidates, therefore, undergo relevant checks and are expected to adhere to the respective standards and principles.
